korean_evidence_only.answer_metrics_reason: Answer metrics are not compared. Synthetic controls and answerer callbacks receive only question, public options and evidence, where evidence is the rendered context ('[Source: path:line]' labels and snippet lines); replayed observations are bound to the evidence hash. Temporal annotations stay on matches and are never rendered into that context. This evaluator also passes no as_of, so as-of and supersession exclusion never act, and withdrawal is deny scope without an annotation, so it has no render-matched counterpart and stays on in both arms. The arm can differ only through retrieved evidence, compared here; re-scoring answers on other evidence would need new model observations, never made here.
korean_evidence_only.arm: same retrieve() call with temporal_filter='annotate_only'; no as_of is passed

tests.mutation_checks: Forcing the control marker on the default path, or keeping exclusion under annotate_only, each made the new tests fail (8 failures each); the source was restored afterwards.

limits: Synthetic fixtures; recall_advanced and recall_hard contain stale notes built to win lexical ranking, so results show that the mechanism acts on those constructed cases, not real-vault prevalence or effect size.
Decision metrics have 0 to 4 nonzero mechanism pairs per fixture; with k nonzero pairs the smallest exact two-sided p is 2^(1-k), so k<=5 can never reach p<0.05 whatever the effect size.
No reader model: temporal annotations are not rendered into context, so reader-side presentation effects are not measured; display_effect here is the non-temporal advanced machinery.
stale_exposure was added after inspecting outputs and is descriptive only; it is not used by the decision rule.
The source paper's numbers are reported by its abstract (English paper; question language not stated) and were not reproduced.
Korean evaluation: the arm is inert by construction (no as_of passed, no validity metadata in the fixture, annotations never rendered); only evidence metrics are compared.
assumptions: Paired values are per-query metric values from the same queries, options and budgets in each arm.
alpha=0.05 two-sided, fixed before the measurement; seed 1707 and 10,000 permutations follow the existing paired_randomization default.
unresolved: No fixture has >=6 validity-sensitive pairs per decision metric, so the defer outcome is power-limited rather than evidence of no mechanism effect.
Reader-model (LLM) answer effects of rendered temporal annotations were not measured; no model calls were made.
Merging with the parallel --lexical-ngrams branch may conflict in evaluate() and retrieve() signatures and main() options.
next_safe_action: Keep the defer default (no richer contested/resolves ledger states). If a decision is needed, add >=6 validity-sensitive paired queries per decision metric and rerun the same commands; an LLM-reader arm needs explicit user approval for model calls.
